title: CPCSC Level 1 device identification and authentication need connection evidence
remediation: The sponsor endpoint identity owner defines the contract-scope devices that must identify and authenticate before connecting. Review enrolment, unique identity and connection policy records. Verify an authorized synthetic device can connect and an unrecognized or de-authorized one is refused before session establishment. The sponsor separately confirms applicability to the CPCSC Level 1 contract and certification boundary. An ITSP.10.171 reference or evidence mapped for a different assessed system establishes no disposition for this contract.

milestones.title: For CPCSC Level 1, collect the assessed device inventory and enrolment requirements, effective connection controls and redacted allow and refusal evidence
